comments.value: I'm part of a DJ event group that regularly turns posters for the current/next event into stickers so they can be applied in any world (we regularly travel to different venues for shows). Being able to share stickers and emoji via the group would be fantastic.
@{62b61f8ec938a62475e4cd14|full_name} I like this idea, but I would also like to see sticker pedestals for world creators too.

Oh i love the idea of join a group and you get exclusive stickers for being in the group so much more than "hey get an achievement for joining 10 groups" 

They'd need to add a tab to the radial wheel like "group exclusive stickers"

details:
Groups should be able to upload stickers that you can copy to your current stickerbook. 

In a perfect world, you could treat them like Discord emojis, where you can use them from whatever group you're in directly, but I can't think of a good UX for that. So, instead, they should be treated like shared stickers, where you click it and it gets added to your set.
title: Group Stickers
